scripts.build:wasm: bash -lc "export EMSDK_QUIET=1; source $HOME/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh && export EM_CACHE=$PWD/.emscripten-cache && emcc src/assets/workers/cpp/2048.cpp -O3 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME=create2048Module -s ENVIRONMENT=worker -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='[_JS_sc,_init_tables]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=[] -s MALLOC=emmalloc -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=0 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=256MB -o src/assets/workers/wasm/2048.js"
scripts.start: npm run build:wasm && npx ng serve
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npx ng build --base-href=/2048-Angular/
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:wasm && npx ng build --configuration production --base-href=/2048-Angular/
scripts.deploy: npm run build:prod && touch dist/2048-angular/browser/.nojekyll && npx gh-pages -d dist/2048-angular/browser --dotfiles
scripts.deploy:check: bash -lc "set -e; curl -I https://zvweiss.github.io/2048-Angular/ | sed -n '1,5p'; curl -I https://zvweiss.github.io/2048-Angular/main.js | sed -n '1,5p'; curl -I https://zvweiss.github.io/2048-Angular/assets/workers/wasm/2048.wasm | sed -n '1,5p'"
